text:
Priya: quick check — can folks confirm owners + final due dates for the RCA action items from last night's outage? I'm updating the RCA doc and want the tracker to match. please reply with owner + YYYY-MM-DD (or 'TBD')

Jordan: I can take the KV cache invalidation fix (item 3). target: 2024-11-07 EOD. will open PR and link it here.

Evan: FYI infra dependency: need eng-infra to backport a kernel patch before we can roll. that blocks any prod rollout; ETA from infra is 2024-11-05 AM. I'm coordinating with @Jordan.

Sarah: i'll own the alert threshold tuning (item 5). due 2024-11-08 COB. will add exact hypothesis and runbook notes to the doc. :thumbsup:

Micah: i'll run the replay/perf validation and smoke tests (item 2). target 2024-11-06 midday. need canary logs access + the test dataset (small). @ops-bot can you confirm access?

ops-bot: access request for Micah submitted to infra-access queue — ticket INFRA-4821. ETA auto-update: 2024-11-05 09:00 UTC.

Jordan: PR opened for cache fix: https://git.redwood.ai/r/cache-fix/compare (draft). tagging @Evan for infra notes.

Priya: thanks — i'm updating the RCA tracker. quick table i added to the doc for clarity:
```
item | owner | due | blocker
1 - traffic routing checks | Priya | 2024-11-05 | none
2 - replay + perf tests | Micah | 2024-11-06 | access (INFRA-4821)
3 - kv cache invalidation | Jordan | 2024-11-07 | infra backport
4 - telemetry retention fix | TBD | TBD | needs triage
5 - alert tuning | Sarah | 2024-11-08 | none
```

Evan: re: item 4 (telemetry) — that one needs a quick triage to decide whether it's infra or runtime. i'll start a short async thread with @eng-ml and @eng-runtime and post back by 2024-11-05.

Micah: ops-bot says access granted to canary logs (INFRA-4821 resolved). pulling data now, will post results in this thread when done.

Priya: awesome — if any dates slip or new blockers appear, ping me directly and i'll escalate. planning a brief sync Thu 10:00 if we need it; otherwise i'll close the tracker after all due dates are met.

Sarah: noted. i'll drop the tuning PR link here before EOD tomorrow.

Jordan: will update PR from draft to ready-for-review once Evan confirms backport schedule.

Micah: replay done, initial perf numbers posted to the RCA doc (section 'replay-results'). no regression >2% on 99p. will attach logs.

Priya: perfect — closing loop on this thread. thanks everyone for the quick turn. :raised_hands:
